evidenceLevel: Human-reviewed acceptance summary, not raw execution evidence. Full receipts are not published in this repository.
executionScope: Audited Windows portable application, isolated offline test fixture on a disposable cloud runner. No user devices or production-cloud validation.

P06.originalRequirement: Reject damaged or other-identity backup with clear feedback and preserve original data.

P05.reviewedResult: Local settings restoration and automatic pre-restore protection were verified.
P05.remaining: The historical cloud-memory delete-and-reimport scenario using the original record identity remains unverified.

R05.reviewedResult: Same-profile resource-cache recovery from backup and preservation of existing data were verified offline.
R05.remaining: The original same-owner second ordinary-profile UI restoration requirement remains unverified.
